# hearing

> Pluggable meeting transcription & context-aware AI agents, batch or live


## Pages in this subsection

- [hearing](hearing.html.md): hearing — pluggable meeting transcription &amp; context-aware AI agents.
- [hearing.agents](hearing.agents.html.md): The agent / “copilot” layer — the actual point of the hearing project.
- [hearing.capture](hearing.capture.html.md): Audio capture and channel handling for the hearing pipeline.
- [hearing.cli](hearing.cli.html.md): Command-line interface for hearing, dispatched with &#96;cw&#96;.
- [hearing.context](hearing.context.html.md): Context stores and retrieval (RAG) for context-connected agents.
- [hearing.diarize](hearing.diarize.html.md): Diarization and speaker labelling for the hearing pipeline.
- [hearing.interfaces](hearing.interfaces.html.md): Facade Protocols for the four pipeline concerns.
- [hearing.pipeline](hearing.pipeline.html.md): Pipeline assembly — compose the four concerns by dependency injection.
- [hearing.storage](hearing.storage.html.md): Transcript persistence via key-value stores (python-storage / &#96;dol&#96;).
- [hearing.stt](hearing.stt.html.md): Speech-to-text for hearing — now backed by the scribed transcription façade.
- [hearing.types](hearing.types.html.md): Shared data model for the hearing pipeline.
- [hearing.vad](hearing.vad.html.md): Voice-activity detection and utterance segmentation — re-exported from scribed.
